# Driver Checklist: macOS Virtual Audio Driver MVP

**Purpose**: Requirement-quality gate for virtual audio devices, routing, passthrough, installer, and recovery.
**Created**: 2026-05-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all required virtual device names, directions, source/sink behavior, and mirror behavior specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001..FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements complete for preventing remote speaker audio from entering the virtual microphone path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements complete for self-routing prevention when a virtual device is selected as its own physical source or output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are installer requirements complete for install, update, repair, rollback, uninstall, restart-required states, and manual cleanup? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023..FR-026]
- [x] CHK005 Are official physical device classes completely enumerated for MVP support and QA coverage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the word "ready" defined through route validation states rather than subjective user perception? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005..FR-005a, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK007 Are "dropped frames", "alignment", "passthrough usable", and "degraded" defined with measurable thresholds or state meanings? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003..SC-006, Data Model §AudioTrack]
- [x] CHK008 Is the selected macOS virtual audio implementation path documented clearly enough for tasks to produce a first proof without reopening product scope? [Clarity, Research §Core Audio]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are driver responsibilities consistent across spec, plan, research, data model, and desktop-driver contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036..FR-037, Contract §Boundary Rules]
- [x] CHK010 Are network/server outage requirements consistent with local passthrough being independent of backend availability? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for permission denied/revoked before onboarding, after onboarding, and mid-session? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for app restart during capture and for truthful recovery of capture/buffer state? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for unsupported Intel Macs and unsupported meeting targets so the product does not imply support? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031..FR-032]
